trajectory.text:
Tomorrow's (2026‑09‑05) order for Northgate is sized for **1,140 covers** — well above a normal day — because the forecast combines two things:

- **Base demand:** 830 covers (typical volume)
- **Plus an event add-on:** 310 covers from a booked event

That pushes total forecast covers to 1,140, which drives the draft order to 95 labor hours and $3,629 in cost, with all 10 stock lines sized to that higher covers count (e.g., 19 cases of chicken thighs, 16 cases of cola syrup, 12 cases of fries, etc.).

There are no local signals currently recorded (no bookings, cancellations, or notes logged), so this 310-cover event bump is coming from the underlying forecast data itself. If you want, I can pull the line-level detail for any specific item (like chicken or buns) to show exactly how that covers number translates into cases — or if you know that event was cancelled, I can log a signal and preview an updated order. Just let me know.

trajectory.text:
I've updated tomorrow's order to reflect the match cancellation. Here's the summary:

**Forecast:** Covers drop from 1,140 → 830 (removed the 310 event covers), labor hours 95 → 70, cost $3,629 → $2,437.

**Case changes:**
| Item | Before | After | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chicken thighs | 19 | 13 | −6 |
| Beef patties | 8 | 5 | −3 |
| Brioche buns | 11 | 7 | −4 |
| Fries | 12 | 8 | −4 |
| Iceberg lettuce | 2 | 2 | 0 (held for expiring stock) |
| Tomatoes | 7 | 5 | −2 |
| Cheddar slices | 2 | 1 | −1 |
| Cola syrup BIB | 16 | 11 | −5 |
| Fryer oil | 0 | 0 | — |
| Fry boxes | 1 | 1 | — |

No warnings on the preview. This is just a preview — the saved order hasn't changed yet. Want me to go ahead and adopt this preview as the new order?

trajectory.text:
## Current Order Overview — Northgate, Service Date 2026-09-05

- **Forecast covers:** 1,140 total (830 base + 310 event)
- **Draft order:** 95 labor hours, $3,629 cost
- No pending signals or pins; draft matches the saved order exactly (all lines **UNCHANGED**), including **Iceberg lettuce at 2 cases**.

## Lettuce Calculation Explained

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Unit | head |
| Case size | 12 heads/case |
| Usage per cover | 0.02 heads |
| On hand | 9 heads |
| Expiring soon | 4 heads (44% of on-hand) |
| Usable stock | 5 heads (9 on hand − 4 expiring) |
| In transit | 0 |
| Safety margin | 5% |
| Safety rationale | "Running out costs more margin than the waste." |

**Demand:** 1,140 covers × 0.02 heads/cover = **22.8 heads**

**Need:** Demand grazed by safety margin, minus usable stock →
- 22.8 × 1.05 ≈ 23.94, minus 5 usable = **18.94 heads** needed from the order

**Cases to order:** 18.94 heads ÷ 12 heads/case = 1.58 → rounded up to **2 cases**

**Why round up and keep a small safety buffer:** Nearly half of on-hand lettuce (4 of 9 heads) is expiring before this can be used, so it's discounted from usable stock. The system applies a modest 5% safety cushion here because running out of lettuce (impacting sandwich builds) is judged costlier than the risk of minor waste. This nets a need of ~19 heads, which rounds up to 2 full cases (24 heads) — comfortably covering demand even with the expiring stock excluded.

The line is marked **UNCHANGED**, meaning no manual pin or override has been applied — this is a straightforward system calculation.

Here's the current Stock section snapshot (last counted 2026-09-04):

## On the Shelf
| Item | On Hand | Expiring Soon |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken thighs | 42 kg | 6 kg |
| Beef patties (150g) | 190 ea | 0 |
| Brioche buns | 180 ea | 24 |
| Fries (2.5kg bags) | 40 kg | 0 |
| Iceberg lettuce | 9 heads | 4 |
| Tomatoes | 7 kg | 3 |
| Cheddar slices | 320 ea | 0 |
| Cola syrup BIB | 30 L | 0 |
| Fryer oil | 25 L | 0 |
| Fry boxes | 600 ea | 0 |

⚠️ Notable expiring risk: buns (24), chicken (6), lettuce (4), tomatoes (3).

## Waste This Week
| Item | Qty Wasted | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken thighs | 6 kg | $40.80 |
| Beef patties | 6 ea | $7.20 |
| Brioche buns | 24 ea | $9.50 |
| Fries | 5 kg | $8.40 |
| Iceberg lettuce | 4 heads | $4.67 |
| Tomatoes | 2 kg | $4.40 |
| Cheese/Cola/Oil/Boxes | 0 | $0.00 |

**Total waste cost: $74.97**

Breakdown by reason:
- Expired: $44.60 (top reason)
- Overproduction: $15.60
- Prep: $13.60
- Dropped: $1.17

Would you like me to log a new waste entry, record a fresh stock count, or dig into the reasons behind any specific item?

- Forecast covers: 1,140 | Required labor: 95 hours
- **Lunch**: 33 required / 33 scheduled (Amara, Diego, Hana, Tom) — no gap

No further action needed unless new absences or demand changes come in before Saturday.

trajectory.text:
Here's the rundown of the Saturday labor review:

**Current Plan (before preview)**
- Forecast covers: 1,140 | Required labor: 95 hours
- **Lunch**: 33 required / 33 scheduled (Amara, Diego, Hana, Tom) — no gap
- **Dinner**: 48 required / 48 scheduled (Priya, Marcus, Sofia, Kwame, Leah, Jonas) — no gap
- **Prep**: 14 required / 14 scheduled (Rosa, Ben) — no gap
- On-call backup available: Nadia Haddad, Sam O'Neill
- No absences or extra-shift signals were on file

**Preview Result**
All three dayparts came back **WITHIN_TOLERANCE** with zero gaps and no recommended actions — the plan was already fully staffed at 95/95 hours, so no shift additions or releases were needed.

**Adoption**
✅ Adopted the plan as-is (revision 2). Total scheduled remains 95 hours, matching required staffing exactly. Undo is available if you need to revert. Nothing was sent outside this page — it's a local roster update only.

No further action needed unless new absences or demand changes come in before Saturday.
